title: 4x Berry Fantasi | 70/30 Shortfill Bundle
description:
Fantasi Berry 70/30 E-Liquid Bundle Pack:
If you’re a fan of our berry-infused vape juices in 70/30 mix, then you’re going to love this bundle! We’ve bundled together our mouthwatering Berry flavors in Fantasi Shortfills so you can save money, whilst stocking up on your favorite E-liquids for no extra cost.
Strawberry Ice
–
Rich, juicy strawberries cooled to sub-zero temperatures
Raspberry Ice-
Tangy, and sweet, raspberry undertones are combined with Koolada’s chilly flavor to produce a vape that has a juicy, icy flavor.
Blue Raspberry Ice –
Delivers all the juicy and sweet notes of the raspberry but with an extra special cooling candy twist.
Blueberry Ice-
Sweet, succulent berries with a touch of sparkle are served over a refreshing bed of ice.
Vape juice is made with a 70/30 mix (70% VG to 30% PG). As VG is thicker than PG, you’ll need a high-powered Sub Ohm device to ensure the E-liquid is vaporised correctly. All of our Fantasi  Vape Liquids come in a range of sizes and strengths.
You can get your 0mg Fantasi 70/30 vape juice in 120ml Shortfill Bottles. If you want nicotine with your Shortfills, we stock 100ml and 120ml bottles at either 3mg or 6mg nicotine strength.
Ingredients
Vegetable Glycerine (70%)
Propylene Glycol (30%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
Nicotine Free, Freebase Nicotine, Or Nicotine Salts
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Raspberry Ice Shortfill
1x Strawberry Ice Shortfill
1x Blueberry Ice Shortfill
1x Blue Raspberry Ice Shortfill
Specifications:
Flavour
Blue Razz, Blueberry, Raspberry, Strawberry
Ratio
70/30
Size
100ml, 120ml
Nicotine Strength
3mg, 6mg
Highlights:
4x berry-infused Fantasi E-liquids for you to try!
Delicious flavours in a 70/30 mix for sub-ohm vaping!
Perfect for cloud-chasing vapers
4 popular berry E-liquids bundled together to save you money
